rows.value: Exempt from IRPP on salaries: family allowances within the legal rates; housing allowance up to 30% of pay; daily transport allowance up to the local fare of six taxi rides (managers) or six bus rides (other staff); documented medical costs; statutory old-age and invalidity pensions.

rows.label: IRPP: monthly withholding on salaries
rows.value: The employer withholds IRPP every month on salaries and similar income, applying the art. 118 scale to the net taxable amount (gross pay less compulsory pension, health and unemployment contributions, art. 70 and 71). Withholding on domestic staff and employees of micro-enterprises is final where that pay is their only income. Since 2026 this monthly IRPP withholding replaces the former professional tax on remuneration (IPR).
